title: Phase B+C — Messenger-grade Android calls
objective: Single ring owner; Answer parallel-mints LiveKit; onCallCreate sends direct FCM; IncomingCallActivity + ConnectionService for system call chrome.
acceptanceCriteria: IncomingCallModule.show is idempotent for the same callId.
answerCall mints LiveKit token in parallel with status update.
IncomingCallActivity and BlypConnectionService are registered in the manifest.
CallScreen defaults to earpiece (speakerOn false) and registers LiveKit globals on mount.
